Messages.Author: Warpath
Messages.Body:
Newbies! Here's a solid deck you can build at home with only two
Tremere starters!

1 Mustafa Rahman
2 Blythe Candeleria
1 Pieter van Dorn
2 Aisling Sturbridge
2 Cohn Rose
1 Muaziz, Archon of Ulugh Beg
1 Rebekka, Chantry Elder of Munich
1 Spiridonas
1 Lucas Halton

Library - 86 cards
Masters
4 Blood Doll
1 Arcanum Chapterhouse, Alexandria
1 Academic Hunting Ground
1 Information Highway
1 Mob Connections
1 Wasserschloss Anif, Austria
1 Protracted Investment

Actions
4 Harass
2 Magic of the Smith
2 Sport Bike
2 Revelations

Action Modifiers
6 Conditioning

Combat
10 Apportation
10 Theft of Vitae
6 Trap
4 Blood Fury
4 Aura Reading
4 Walk of Flame

Reaction
8 Forced Awakening
6 Deflection
3 Enhanced Senses
3 Spirit's Touch
2 Precognition

This deck will usually bleed or harass its prey. If blocked, trap,
apporatation, steal blood, press, walk of flame into torpor. If not
blocked, slap the conditioning to bleed for 3. If you are deflected
you are not bleeding at stealth and can even "Play nice" by
maneuvering to long and waving. You can also harass you predator,
play aura reading to find out what kind of nastiness he has in his
hand. Your intercept should be enough to stop stealth bleed decks and
your Magic of the Smith should help you get to the sport bikes
quickly. You can only have one vehicle per minion but the sport bike
is not unique so two different minions can "ride".

The biggest shortcoming of this deck is the lack of counter against
strike: combat ends. Telepathic tracking would be a great addition
but is hard to come by. Thoughts betrayed works well but is costly
and requires superior dominate (only Lucas and Spiradonis can use it).
If you get some dominate skill cards, then you can up Aisling, Cohn
or Muaziz to superior dominate and make the TB worth it.

Messages.Author: Hollowboy
Messages.Body:
tore...@hotmail.com (Warpath) wrote in message news:<28818c16.02091...@posting.google.com>...

> Newbies! Here's a solid deck you can build at home with only two
> Tremere starters!

This is very good!

And, it's nice to see that, even with a bigger card pool, there are
not many (obvious) modifications to make - I can see that using some
other wakes rather than all all forced might help, and swapping a
master or two would help - e.g. an Arcane Library would be better than
Protracted Investment. But mostly, it's as good as it will get, for
Tremere with a bit of everything.

Other cards I would consider as cute but not essential are Charnas,
and a Cryptic Mission or two. Charnas and Cryptics combo well with
your + stealth vamps - put an enemy in a hunt loop with +2 stealth
actions.

And a soul burn or two might be nice - that's a weapon hoser + screws
fortitude, if I remember correctly.

>

> The biggest shortcoming of this deck is the lack of counter against
> strike: combat ends.

I don't think this is so bad. If your minions are blocking all their
important actions, it doesn't matter too much if you don't toast the
vampire taking the actions. Just stopping the action is good enough, a
lot of the time.

And you can cycle anyway - you won't jam up due to their combat ends.
If a combat-ends deck is all your bleeds, you can play Conditioning
and combat stuff anyway, (if you really need to un-jam). Similarly,
when blocking a combat-ends deck, you can cycle trap, aura reading,
apportation and a strike, if you are desperately trying to get the
next untap / intercept card...
